title: Create a new event with staff assignments
description: A coordinator can create a new PR event with details and assigned staff so it is ready for operational use.

steps.description: Navigate to /events/new
Fill in the event title with a new PR event name
Fill in a valid event date
Fill in a valid event time
Fill in the location field with a valid venue
Select a department
Fill in the note field with event details
Assign at least one staff member and role
Create the event
Verify the new event detail page is displayed
Verify the created event is displayed

title: Review assigned tasks and acknowledge one
description: This verifies that an assigned staff member can view their mobile task list and acknowledge a task, and the acknowledgment is reflected in the UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /mobile/my-tasks
Verify assigned tasks are displayed
Click acknowledge for one assigned task
Verify the task is marked as acknowledged

title: Acknowledge mobile task assignments
description: An assigned staff member can open the mobile task view and acknowledge their PR task assignments on a phone-sized screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /mobile/my-tasks
Verify assigned tasks are displayed
Acknowledge one task assignment
Verify the task is marked acknowledged

title: View dashboard insights and navigate to operations views
description: A user can open the dashboard, review KPI and summary information, and navigate onward to the schedule or reports for operational review.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify KPI summary information is displayed
Verify smart summary information is displayed
Click the link to view the schedule
Verify the schedule is displayed
Navigate to /
Click the link to view reports
Verify management reporting content is displayed

title: View dashboard summary and navigate to schedule
description: A user can open the dashboard, review the operational summary, and jump to the schedule for day-to-day planning.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify KPI summary cards are displayed
Verify smart summary insights are displayed
Click the link to open the schedule
Verify the schedule page is displayed

title: Browse the schedule and open an event detail
description: A user can browse the schedule, use the available views or filters, and open an event detail page from the schedule.

steps.description: Navigate to /schedule
Verify scheduled events are displayed
Select a different schedule view
Verify the schedule remains displayed in the selected view
Apply a schedule filter
Verify filtered events are displayed
Open an event from the schedule
Verify the event detail page is displayed

title: Publish or complete an event from its detail page
description: A user can change an event lifecycle status so the event is marked as published or completed in the detail view.

steps.description: Navigate to /schedule
Open an event from the schedule
Publish or complete the event
Verify the event lifecycle status is updated
Verify the event detail page still shows the event

title: Review mobile tasks and acknowledge an assignment
description: An assigned staff member can open the mobile task view, review assigned work, and acknowledge a task on a phone-sized screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /mobile/my-tasks
Verify assigned tasks are displayed
Acknowledge one task assignment
Verify the task is marked as acknowledged

title: Browse events in table, month, and week views
description: A user can switch between schedule views and still see the event list update appropriately for planning.

steps.description: Navigate to /schedule
Switch to the month calendar view
Verify the month calendar view is displayed
Switch to the week calendar view
Verify the week calendar view is displayed
Switch back to the table view
Verify the event table is displayed

title: View the office monitor schedule
description: This verifies that office staff can open the monitor page and see today’s and upcoming events in the signage layout.

steps.description: Navigate to /monitor
Verify today’s and upcoming events are displayed in a monitor-safe layout

title: Create a new event and save it
description: A user can create a new PR event with required details and save it as an event record.

steps.description: Navigate to /events/new
Fill in the event title field with a unique event name
Fill in the event date field with a valid date
Fill in the event time field with a valid time
Select the event department
Submit the event form
Verify the new event is created
Verify the event detail page is displayed

title: Open an event from the schedule
description: A user can select an event from the schedule and open its detail page for review.

steps.description: Navigate to /schedule
Open an event from the schedule
Verify the event detail page is displayed
Verify event information is displayed

title: Edit an event and save a meaningful change
description: A user can open an existing event, make a significant update, and save it so the revised details are visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /schedule
Open an event from the schedule
Click the link to edit the event
Change the event note or another editable detail
Save the event changes
Verify the updated event detail page is displayed
Verify the revised event details are displayed

title: Create a new event and assign staff with roles
description: A user can create an event and assign staff members with roles before saving so the event has the expected staffing setup.

steps.description: Navigate to /events/new
Fill in the event title field with a unique staffed event name
Fill in the event date field with a valid date
Fill in the event time field with a valid time
Add a staff member to the event
Assign a role to the staff member
Submit the event form
Verify the new event is created with staff assignments
Verify assigned roles are displayed

title: Cancel an event with a required reason
description: A user can cancel an event only after providing a cancellation reason so the cancellation is recorded correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to /schedule
Open an event from the schedule
Choose to cancel the event
Fill in a cancellation reason
Confirm the cancellation
Verify the event is marked as canceled
Verify the cancellation reason is displayed

title: Create a new event and resolve schedule conflicts before saving
description: A user can create an event, review any conflict warning, and still save the event after handling the conflict information shown in the UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /events/new
Fill in the event title field with a unique event name
Fill in the event date field with a valid date
Fill in the event time field with a valid time that overlaps an existing schedule item
Submit the event form
Verify a schedule conflict warning is visible
Continue saving the event
Verify the new event is created
